newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Days Inn seeking to expand Israel presence.
newsitem.headline: Days Inn seeking to expand Israel presence.

text.p: The U.S. hotel company Days Inn is seeking to set up franchise hotels in small towns around Israel, the company's Israeli subsidiary said on Monday.

Rafi Farber, president of Days Inn for Israel and the Middle East, said he had been holding talks with hotel owners in Israel's northern and central regions over the last several weeks. Days Inn is looking for hotels of approximately 100 rooms.
"Hotel owners, particularly in towns which have only one hotel, such as Metulla, Nazareth, Nahariya and Ashkelon, have shown considerable interest," Days Inn said in a statement.

Days Inn currently manages a 170-room hotel in the northern resort town of Tiberias and recently reached a franchise agreement with a suite hotel in Jerusalem. In addition to setting up a network of franchise in outlying towns, the company said it planned to expand its Jersualem presence to 800 rooms.
Days Inn is controlled by HFS Inc of the United States, which has interests in hotel and tourism.
